role: Treatment integrity policy for the H2X primary treatment. Bound into configs/phase2_ablation_stcore_v1.json via policy_config.h2x_policy_sha256 and checked fail-closed by scripts/run2b_executor.py. Scope: which inputs may enter any Phase-2 arm. Endpoints stay in docs/paper/primary_endpoints.json; this file never changes a scientific endpoint.
treatment_statement: The H2X primary treatment is river-graph transport with the ecological context encoder over the full frozen information set, trained with the frozen training budget and the frozen multi-seed ensemble. Everything outside this statement is a different arm or a forbidden input.
frozen_information_set: 13-col standardized regime block (hydro in node input, cols 4:13 in the encoder)
visible-DOC field under obs_mask = train U val U context (test DOC never visible)
river graph (edge_index + edge_attr) for GNN arms only
hard_input_exclusions: explicit network distance (km or hop) from the target cell to monitored stations as a model input feature
k-nearest geographic neighbour coordinates or neighbour-distance features as model inputs
target-basin mean pooling of labels outside the frozen visibility rule
any 'nearest' / distance-to-nearest-station input feature used as a model predictor
query/test ground-truth DOC in any form (feature, pool, aggregate, selection rule at prediction time)
exclusion_enforcement: run2b_executor verifies the policy hash and the arm feature contract before dispatch; tests/test_phase2_controls.py and tests/test_phase2_2c_policy.py pin the contract; audits re-check sidecars. Distance-to-nearest is allowed only as an evaluation-side covariate (e.g. per-station UNEVAW context), never as a predictor input.
note: Recreated 2026-09-24 after the previous policy file was lost in an external session rollback; this file is canonical from this date and is bound by hash everywhere.
